role: Pure static geometry/physiology helpers used by the live workout path and fact resolvers: track length, nearest fix, local pace, route-index lookup, bearings and turn labels, %maxHR zone, breadcrumb decimation, km chunks and the trailing grade window.
types: WorkoutGeometry: enum — namespace of pure static functions
WorkoutGeometry.SplitChunk: struct — distance span and sample offsets of one >=1 km chunk

units.does: Sums great-circle distance (CLLocation.distance) between consecutive fixes of a track and returns metres; 0 for fewer than 2 fixes. Includes every step, paused or not.

branches.effect: adds distance from previous fix to total

units.does: Linear scan returning (index, distance) of the fix in track nearest target; returns (0, +infinity) for an empty track. Used by AppFactResolver+WorkoutDetail.swift:719.

branches.effect: records new closest index/distance; otherwise keeps previous

units.does: Pace in sec/km over fixes [idx-5, idx+5] clamped to the track: (end.timestamp-start.timestamp)/(straight-line distance/1000); nil when the straight-line span <=5 m or <=1 s. Straight-line (not path) distance overstates pace on curves. Crashes (index out of range) on an empty track since hi = -1. Used by AppFactResolver+WorkoutDetail.swift:728 after nearestFix.

flags.text: Indexes track[lo]/track[hi] without an emptiness guard; an empty track gives hi=-1 and traps. Only safe because the caller passes a non-empty track.

units.does: Returns the first index after startIdx whose cumulative distance is >= dists[startIdx]+meters; nil when startIdx is out of range or no such index (end of route).

branches.effect: returns nil; otherwise searches dists[startIdx+1...] with firstIndex

units.does: Initial great-circle bearing from Route.Point a to b in degrees, normalised to [0,360) (0=N, 90=E).

flags.text: Same initial-bearing formula is implemented separately in GetMeBackView.bearing, SavedRouteStepBuilder.bearing, RoadGeocodingSupport bearingDegrees and RoadAwarenessEngine.bearingDegrees.

units.does: Returns b-a wrapped into (-180, +180]; positive = right turn.

branches.effect: adds 360 repeatedly; otherwise d returned unchanged

units.does: Maps a signed bearing delta to a spoken label: |d|>=150 "U-turn", >=110 "hard right/left", >=60 "right/left", else "soft right/left"; side is right when delta>=0.
Returns the 1-5 %maxHR zone for hr: <60% ->1, <70% ->2, <80% ->3, <90% ->4, else 5; nil when hr is nil or maxHR<=0. Used for threshold signals (WorkoutRecorder+Context.swift:401).

flags.text: Doc says anything below 60% reads as zone 1 "so a zone threshold and the zone shown to the user always agree", but the displayed zone breakdown WorkoutZoneBreakdown.zoneIndex returns nil (uncounted) below 50%, so a sub-50% HR is zone 1 for thresholds but no zone in the breakdown; two separate implementations of the same band model.

units.does: Decimates a track into breadcrumb fixes: starts with origin, then appends each later fix with horizontalAccuracy>0 that is >=25 m from or >=30 s after the last committed fix. Returns [] for an empty track.

branches.cond: for each fix after the first
neither moved >=25 m nor >=30 s elapsed
branches.effect: skips; otherwise appends BreadcrumbFix and makes it the new reference

flags.text: Comment calls this a 'mirror of BreadcrumbRecorder throttle' but it omits BreadcrumbRecorder's horizontalAccuracy<=100 m rejection, so post-hoc decimated breadcrumbs can include fixes the live recorder would drop; the first track fix is also never accuracy-checked (used only as reference).

units.does: Splits a sample series into consecutive chunks of >=1000 m cumulative distance, each with start/end distance and offsetSec; the trailing partial km is dropped; samples without distance are skipped.

branches.cond: distanceMeters nil or < 1000 m past chunk start
branches.effect: skips; otherwise closes a chunk and starts the next at this sample

units.does: Walks the track backwards summing step distances until >=100 m; returns the start index of that window and the metres covered (whole track, start 0, when shorter). Includes paused steps since track keeps paused fixes.

branches.cond: for i from last down to 1

branches.effect: sets startIdx=i-1 and stops; otherwise continues to start (startIdx stays 0)

flags.text: `1 ..< track.count` traps (lowerBound > upperBound) on an empty track; safe only because the sole caller guards track.count >= 2.
